simple.meaning: שֹׁטֵט (shôṭêṭ) is a Hebrew word meaning “to flog ; a goad.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.

definitions.full: H7850. shotet שֹׁטֵט noun [masculine] scourge ; — absolute ׳שׁ בְּצִדֵּיבֶם Josh 23:13 (D; national scourge; < read שׁוֺטִים ).
definitions.rootNote: active participle of an otherwise unused root meaning (properly, to pierce; but only as a denominative from 7752 )

occurrences.englishText: know for a certainty that Yahweh your God will no longer drive these nations from out of your sight; but they shall be a snare and a trap to you, a scourge in your sides, and thorns in your eyes, until you perish from off this good land which Yahweh your God has given you.
